name: namespace_qualify_propagation
description: Re-qualify the next bare call with its package namespace (proposals_v1 rank 1). Reverse-strip construction from the normalized CRAN corpus: in a file where one package's `pkg::` prefixes were stripped from the prompt-side state, an earlier occurrence is already restored (the propagation event, visible in the prefix) and the cursor sits immediately before the next bare callee; the completion re-adds `pkg::` and the rest of the line. Ground truth is the original corpus line text from the cursor - exact by construction (tier 1).
novelty_note: No existing family edits call heads: rename_propagation renames identifiers, pipe_rewrite swaps operators. This teaches explicit pkg:: qualification (the FDA-submission convention over library() attachment) with the event-teaches-target-repeats geometry that scored 92% for rename. Fully corpus-side (reverse-strip): generated via the mock backend - the model draw is not the gate; exactness is enforced on the constructed row (qualified_call_cursor: prefix+target rebuilds the corpus line byte-for-byte). Deviation from the proposal: the cases-harness scenario_block check forbids a non-empty event_diff, so the restore event is encoded as the already-qualified earlier line inside the prefix instead of a diff block.
